杨童看着胡九郎故作底气十足的样子，嘴角忍不住微微上扬，那抹熟悉的、清冷却鲜活的神色，终于重新回到了她的脸上。

“你少贫嘴，你的身体刚刚好，别总这么大意，若是再落下病根，又要麻烦别人。”

两人你一言我一语，之前的隔阂与僵持，在这一刻彻底烟消云散。阳光透过树叶的缝隙，洒下斑驳的光影，落在两人身上。

不远处林佳和范梦雪看到这一幕，相视一笑，心中都松了口气。

阡陌端着刚煮好的粥走过来，挠了挠头，憨厚地笑道：

“胡大哥，杨姐，你们和好了？”

杨童不置可否。

“这段时间，辛苦大家了。”

正说着话，李二牛从外面走了进来，看到杨童恢复往日模样，他轻轻颔首。

“丫头，你能想通就好，过去的事情，本就不该成为你的枷锁。”

杨童站起身。

“多谢李大哥提点，以后我不会再纠结于过往，会和大家一起应对接下来的事情。”

一切都显得平静而祥和，可下一秒，整个小院突然剧烈震动了一下，地面微微开裂，院子四周的黄符突然发出“滋滋”的声响，金光骤暗，原本笼罩在小院上空的无形屏障，瞬间变得扭曲起来，像是被什么东西狠狠撞击着。

李二牛脸色骤变，立刻停下手中的动作，厉声喝道：

“不好！有情况！是阵法攻击！有人在外面布下了破阵之术，想要冲破我们的防御！”

话音刚落小院再次震动，这一次的震动更加剧烈，院墙上的黄符纷纷脱落，化作一缕缕金光消散在空中，院子里的阴气瞬间暴涨，一股刺骨的寒意，顺着地面蔓延开来，夹杂着浓郁的杀气。

胡九郎立刻站起身，手中快速捏出法诀，几张符箓瞬间脱手，贴在院子四周，试图稳住即将破碎的屏障。

“李大哥，你快看看，对方布的是什么阵，破绽在哪里？”

李二牛神色凝重，目光快速扫视着院子四周，指尖掐诀，嘴里念念有词，片刻后，沉声道：

Seeing Hu Jiulang pretending to be confident, Yang Tong couldn't help but raise the corners of her mouth slightly, and that familiar, cool and lively look finally returned to her face.

"Don't talk too much. Your health is just right. Don't be so careless all the time. If you get sick again, you will trouble others."

The two of them exchanged words with each other, and the previous estrangement and stalemate completely disappeared at this moment.The sun shines through the gaps in the leaves, casting mottled light and shadow on the two of them.

Not far away, Lin Jia and Fan Mengxue saw this scene, smiled at each other, and felt relieved.

Qian Mo came over with the freshly cooked porridge, scratched his head, and said with a simple smile:

"Brother Hu, Sister Yang, have you reconciled?"

Yang Tong was noncommittal.

"Thanks to everyone for your hard work during this time."

Just as he was talking, Li Erniu walked in from outside. Seeing that Yang Tong had returned to his usual appearance, he nodded gently.

"Girl, as long as you can figure it out, the past should not be a shackles for you."

Yang Tong stood up.

"Thank you, Brother Li, for the reminder. I will no longer dwell on the past and will deal with the next things together with everyone."

Everything seemed calm and peaceful, but the next second, the whole courtyard suddenly shook violently, the ground cracked slightly, the yellow symbols around the courtyard suddenly made a "sizzling" sound, the golden light suddenly dimmed, and the invisible barrier that originally shrouded the courtyard became distorted in an instant, as if it was hit hard by something.

Li Erniu's expression suddenly changed, he immediately stopped what he was doing and shouted sternly:

"No! There's a situation! It's a formation attack! Someone has set up a formation-breaking technique outside to break through our defenses!"

As soon as he finished speaking, the small courtyard shook again, this time the vibration was more violent. The yellow symbols on the courtyard wall fell off one after another, turning into wisps of golden light and dissipating in the air. The Yin Qi in the courtyard instantly surged, and a biting chill spread along the ground, mixed with a strong murderous aura.

Hu Jiulang immediately stood up and quickly formed a spell in his hand. Several talismans were instantly removed from his hands and stuck around the courtyard, trying to stabilize the barrier that was about to be broken.

"Brother Li, look quickly, what kind of formation the other party has set up, and where are the flaws?"

Li Erniu's expression was solemn, his eyes quickly glanced around the yard, he made secrets with his fingertips, and muttered words. After a moment, he said in a deep voice:
